relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: Morphine reversed these neuropathic neural dynamics and reduced affective-motivational behaviours without altering sensory detection or reflexive responses

relationships.subject: MOR
relationships.evidence_quote: ACC MORs are both necessary and sufficient for the affective pain relief produced by clinically relevant morphine doses

relationships.subject: MORp chemogenetic gene therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: This opioid-mimetic chemogenetic gene therapy recapitulated the analgesic effects of morphine during chronic neuropathic pain

key_findings: ACC MORs are necessary and sufficient for morphine relief of affective pain; morphine reverses neuropathic ACC dynamics.
MOR promoter-driven chemogenetic inhibition of opioid-sensitive ACC neurons mimics morphine analgesia.
